name: Mike Repole
note: US beverage entrepreneur (co-founder of Vitaminwater/Glaceau and BodyArmor). Bought a majority stake in NOBULL in 2023 through Impact Capital, the private-equity arm of his family office (CNBC, 2023-07-20; that page 403s for scripts). SGB Media (2026-08-22) describes Repole as the majority owner of NOBULL, with Tom Brady the second-largest shareholder after the 2024 TB12 merger. Personal ownership, treated as a private owner, not a state.
